title: Pinned real Ribasim full-allocation / physical-reduction conflict

dependency_gate.implementation_rule: No DUMMY-19C generator/verifier or workflow gate before DUMMY-19B closes and the implementation baseline is rebound.

purpose: Use the pinned real Ribasim allocator and physical UserDemand solver in one custom case where management allocates the full two-recipient demand but physical min_level reduction supplies only about half, thereby directly testing the DUMMY-15B allocation-versus-realization distinction.

source_semantics.allocation: Pinned allocation_optim.jl does not use UserDemand.min_level in the UserDemand demand/priority objective or flow upper bound; a higher-priority LevelDemand holds forecast Basin storage so the 60 m3/day fixed inflow is fully assigned to the two UserDemand claims.
source_semantics.physical: Pinned solve.jl multiplies each UserDemand inflow-link allocated target by the source Basin low-storage factor and reduction_factor(source_level-min_level, level_difference_threshold).
source_semantics.reduction_function: phi(x)=0 for x<0; phi(x)=(-2*x/t+3)*(x/t)^2 for 0<=x<t; phi(x)=1 for x>=t; pinned t=0.02 m.
source_semantics.supplied_authority: Direct Basin->UserDemand physical linkflow integrated over the horizon is the primary supplied authority. Allocation-output supplied remains lagged as qualified by DUMMY-19A.

basin.depth_threshold_control: Initial and final depth remain approximately 1 m, so the pinned low-storage factor is exactly 1 throughout this experiment.

level_hold.meaning: Allocation forecast is constrained to zero Basin storage change, so the allocator must use the 60 m3/day inflow rather than initial Basin storage.

independent_continuous_reference.ode: A dh/dtau = 60 * (1 - phi(h-0.99)), with tau in days and common physical reduction on both allocated UserDemand links.
independent_continuous_reference.ledger: 60 m3 fixed inflow = total supplied + Basin storage gain.

hypotheses: Both real Ribasim priority cases allocate the full 40 m3/day root demand and full 20 m3/day external demand because forecast supply is 60 m3/day and the priority-1 LevelDemand prevents planned storage drawdown.
Despite full allocation, direct physical UserDemand linkflows are reduced because source_level-min_level starts at 0.01 m, giving the pinned smooth reduction factor exactly 0.5.
Because both recipients share the same source Basin and min_level, their physical supplied linkflows have an exact 2:1 ratio at every physical sample, independent of allocation priority.

Integrated physical supply over one day is approximately 30.0674 m3, with root approximately 20.0449 m3 and external approximately 10.0225 m3; a predeclared tolerance of 0.05 m3 on each integrated quantity is allowed for solver discretization/output integration.
Final Basin level is approximately 1.00002993 m and the Basin storage gain equals 60 m3 minus integrated physical UserDemand supply within 0.05 m3.
Reversing root/external demand_priority does not change allocation, supplied split, Basin trajectory or total supplied water in this full-allocation case.

The pinned real Ribasim behavior in this controlled common-factor case matches the structural proportional-reduction oracle from DUMMY-15B and differs from the DUMMY-15B priority-preserving curtailment oracle.
Allocated-but-unsupplied volume is a management/realization discrepancy only and never enters a physical water ledger as if transferred.
DUMMY-19C does not establish proportional reduction for arbitrary different sources/min_level values; it establishes it only for this deliberately common-factor controlled case.
measurements: per-UserDemand demand and allocated rates from the real allocation state/result
direct Basin2->UserDemand3 and Basin2->UserDemand4 physical flow time series
integrated physical supplied volumes from direct linkflow
priority-order comparison across otherwise identical models
forbidden: no modification of pinned Ribasim source
no use of allocation result as physical supply authority
no tuning min_level, area or tolerances after observing DUMMY-19C output
no claim that the common-factor proportional result generalizes to multiple source Basins or unequal physical reduction factors
authority_rebind_note: DUMMY-19C preregistration/concept were prepared while DUMMY-19B was pending. No DUMMY-19C executable code existed then. Implementation baseline was rebound after DUMMY-19B qualified; model parameters, independent reference values and tolerances were not changed.
